# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 101 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 51 | Coptic

---

## Saying 101

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever does not hate his father and his mother in my way will not be able to be a disciple to me. And whoever does not love his father and his mother in my way will not be able to be a disciple to me. For my mother gave me death, but my true mother gave me life."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Parallel to Luke 14:26 / Matthew 10:37; Thomas adds a second clause inverting the first and a concluding cryptic statement about two mothers
- "Hate father and mother" — the radical discipleship demand
- "Love father and mother in my way" — Thomas adds an alternative: loving in Jesus's way is also required
- "My mother gave me death" — the biological/earthly mother as the source of mortal birth
- "My true mother gave me life" — the divine/spiritual mother (Holy Spirit? Sophia? The divine feminine?) as the source of true life
- The two-mother concept is unique to Thomas and connects to Syriac Christian tradition where the Holy Spirit is feminine
